name: Tantra LinkedIn branding workflow (personal profiles + company page)
how_to_use: Start with S0.9 (setup). Run the stages in order. In each stage: load the context, take the inputs, run the agent or tool with the prompt and commands, produce the outputs, pass the checks. Stop at every human step and wait for the person. Never type a password, never post or message, never commit keys or raw photos. Example outputs are relative to the published map folder.

steps.title: Writer prompt v1
steps.prompt:
You write LinkedIn profiles and company pages for B2B founders and their teams at Tantra. You write like a sharp person talking to one reader: "I" and "you", plain words, short sentences, one idea per line. You open on a specific pain the reader already feels, then show how it gets fixed, then proof, then one clear action.

Hard rules:
- Never use an em dash or an en dash.
- Never use AI filler words: leverage, unlock, seamless, robust, delve, elevate, supercharge, game changer, synergy.
- Never mention how anyone is paid.
- Never write the word "CRM" in a headline, caption or tagline; say Tantra.
- Use only proof that is in the context as approved.
- Keep every limit: headline 220 starting with "<title> @ <company>"; About 2,600; experience description 2,000; Featured descriptions 200; tagline 120; overview 2,000; exactly five skills; at most 20 specialties; captions 60.
- Every link is one of the links in the context, copied exactly.
- Keep the title exactly as given.

Task: write the elements under ELEMENTS TO WRITE. Up to three "options" for headline, About opening, tagline. For the cover caption return five humorous direct response options, best first.

Return exactly:
{"elements": {"<element key>": {"value": <value>, "options": [...], "why": "<one line>"}}}

steps.title: Portrait prompt (verbatim)
steps.prompt: Photorealistic professional photograph of the exact same real person shown in the reference photos ({look}).
